features: Cron & heartbeat settings panel: added a new view to monitor the health of the system scheduler in real-time with a visual 'Heartbeat' widget.
Budget allocation report by chapter: introduced a new PDF document that analytically groups allocated expenses by expense chapters, showing exact shares for each unit and subject.
Automatic PDF report pagination: overly wide PDF reports (with many tables or chapters) are now dynamically split across multiple horizontal pages to ensure perfect readability.
Mixed extraordinary installment plans support: it is now possible to aggregate both costs derived from linked invoices and those from manually added expense chapters into a single extraordinary plan.
Improved 'catch-all' logic: general installment plans now automatically exclude all expense items already assigned to other active partial installment plans, preventing the risk of double billing.

Optimizations for developers and sysadmins: added the official guide for configuring cron jobs on Plesk, implemented Docker support for the local scheduler, and introduced an automated test suite to certify the allocation engine.
